description: Update a contact (identified by ID or email). `list_ids` replaces the membership set; `list_ids_included`/`list_ids_excluded` add/remove without disturbing the rest.

contact_identifier.description: Contact ID or email to update.

email.description: New email address for the contact.

fields.description: Custom field values to set, keyed by merge tag. String, number, or boolean values.

list_ids.description: Replace the contact's list memberships with this exact set of list IDs.

list_ids_excluded.description: List IDs to remove the contact from.

list_ids_included.description: List IDs to add the contact to (additive).

unsubscribed.description: Move the contact to `unsubscribed` (`true`) or `subscribed` (`false`) status.

name: update-contact
